title: Capability closure is resolved before availability and attach admission
blocker: The executable E2 reference-model runner proves the closure algorithm only. The production inventory publisher, qualification/reset/action providers, capability query and attach-admission consumers have not been mapped, integrated or closed by E3 product evidence.
assertions: mandatory dependency action, exact qualification and reset contracts reach a bounded fixed point
same-bundle free and busy inputs preserve bundle/capability/policy/snapshot hashes while changing decision availability
missing or unauthenticated facts, stale snapshot identity, conflicts and closure overflow fail closed
capability query performs no modeled bind, reset or lease write
